attempted_claim: Let f_{c,b}(x,y)=(x^2+c-by,x) with 0<|b|<1/4 be quasi-hyperbolic in the sense of Bedford–Smillie, assume its Julia set J_{c,b}=J^+ cap J^- is connected, and assume f_{c,b} is not uniformly hyperbolic (hence there is a tangency between W^u(x_1) and W^s(x_2) for some x_1,x_2 in the closure of the saddle set). Do all Bedford–Smillie external rays land on J, and is J homeomorphic to a finite quotient of the real solenoid (in particular locally connected)?
decisive_failure: The investigation attempted three independent routes (2D Yoccoz puzzle, 1D renormalization transfer, abstract solenoid quotient) plus a local normal-form modulus check, but established no proved theorem, counterexample, or invariant; the target remains open and all conclusions about the blocker are diagnostic rather than auditable claims.
